info.title: Pulsenote API
info.description: Send transactional emails at scale. Authenticate every request with your API key in the `X-API-Key` header. Find your key in the Pulsenote dashboard under Settings → API Keys.

post.description:
Queues an email for delivery. Returns immediately with the notification ID.

**Sandbox:** if your account has no verified sending domain yet, the message is rendered and stored for preview but never delivered, and the response comes back with `status: "SANDBOX"` and `sandbox: true`. Everything else behaves identically — including the `from` address you pass — so verifying a domain in Settings is the only change needed to start sending for real. Sandbox is capped at 50 messages/month and does not consume your plan allowance.
Queues up to 500 emails in one call. Each message is validated independently; the response reports per-message queued/rejected status.

api-key.name: X-API-Key
api-key.description: Your tenant API key. Find it in the dashboard under Settings → API Keys.

domain.description: Domain to send from, e.g. mail.example.com.

fromEmail.description: Default from address for this domain. Defaults to noreply@<domain>.

fromName.description: Default display name for this domain.

region.description: AWS region to host this domain’s SES identity in (data residency / jurisdiction of processing). Must be a supported region; defaults to the platform region if omitted.

email.description: Address to suppress. Normalised to lower case and trimmed.

stream.description: Stream to suppress on. Suppression is per stream, so blocking a broadcast address still lets transactional mail through.

messages.description: Up to 500 messages to queue in one call.

region.description: AWS SES region this domain sends from (null = platform default).

spfVerified.description: Whether the SPF (MAIL FROM) record is verified.

dmarcVerified.description: Whether a DMARC policy is present.

fromEmail.description: Default from address for this domain.

isDefault.description: Whether this is the tenant default sender domain.

dnsRecords.description: DNS records to publish (returned on add/verify).

filename.description: File name shown to the recipient, e.g. `invoice-2026-08.pdf`.

contentId.description: Embed the file in the HTML body instead of listing it as a download. Reference it as `cid:<contentId>` in your HTML.

templateId.description: ID of the template used, if any.

templateName.description: Name of the template used, if any.

sentAt.description: When the email was handed to the provider.

failureReason.description: Reason for failure, if failed or bounced.

complaints.description: Messages reported as spam by a recipient.

accepted.description: Messages the provider accepted for delivery.

deliveryRate.description: Share of processed messages the provider accepted, as a percentage. Still-queued messages are excluded from the denominator.

bounceRate.description: Share of processed messages that bounced.

complaintRate.description: Share of accepted messages reported as spam.

thisMonth.description: Total notifications sent this calendar month.

daily.description: Per-day counts by status for the last 30 days.

engagement.description: Complaint count and the number of messages the provider accepted. Open and click counts are deliberately absent — SES is not configured to emit those events, so any figure here would be a constant zero.

rates.description: Delivery, bounce and complaint rates across all streams.

byStream.description: The same totals and rates split by message stream. Every stream is present even with no traffic, so an empty one is distinguishable from an unsupported one. Notifications sent before streams existed count as transactional, which is what they were.

data.description: Sample data to interpolate into the template.

cc.description: Carbon-copy recipients, visible to everyone on the message. Accepts a single address or a list. Counts toward the 50-recipient limit shared with `to` and `bcc`.

bcc.description: Blind-carbon-copy recipients, hidden from other recipients. Accepts a single address or a list. Counts toward the 50-recipient limit shared with `to` and `cc`.

replyTo.description: Where replies should go, when that differs from `from`. Accepts a single address or a list. Unlike `from`, these addresses do not need to be on a verified domain.

attachments.description: Files to attach, up to 20 per message and 10 MB in total (decoded).

from.description: Sender address on a verified domain. Defaults to the tenant default sender.

subject.description: Email subject line. Ignored when a template supplies its own subject.

templateId.description: Send using a stored template by ID.

templateSlug.description: Send using a stored template by slug.

locale.description: Locale of the template variant to use (e.g. en, pl).

html.description: Raw HTML body (when not using a template).

stream.description: Message stream — transactional (default) or broadcast. Isolates reputation + suppression.

status.description: Status at time of acceptance. `QUEUED` for a normal send. `SANDBOX` when the account has no verified sending domain — the message is rendered and stored for preview but never delivered.

from.description: Resolved sender address the email will be sent from.

sandbox.description: Present and `true` only in sandbox mode. Check this in your integration tests to assert you are sending for real. Verify a sending domain to leave sandbox — no code changes are required.

message.description: Human-readable explanation, returned in sandbox mode.

counts.description: Count keyed by status, for this stream only.

rates.description: Rates for this stream. Separating them is the point of streams.

email.description: Suppressed address, always stored lower-cased and trimmed.

stream.description: Suppression is per stream: blocking a marketing address does not stop a password reset.

reason.description: bounce and complaint are added automatically from provider feedback; manual is yours.

detail.description: Provider text for an automatic entry, or a note for a manual one.

fromEmail.description: From address for this domain. Must be on the domain itself.

fromName.description: Display name recipients see for mail sent from this domain. Set it per domain when one account sends under several brands. Empty string clears it and falls back to the account name.

isDefault.description: Make this the domain used when a send omits `from`.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier, unique per tenant + locale.

locale.description: Locale of this variant (e.g. en, pl). Defaults to en.
